newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Coplex Energy to offer shares.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Coplex Energy to offer shares.

text.p: Philippine oil exploration firm Coplex Energy Corp is seeking to raise 265.5 million pesos from a proposed initial public offering by year-end, a company disclosure to the Securities and Exchange Commission said.
The disclosure, released by the SEC on Monday, said of the total proceeds, 68 million pesos would be used to acquire stakes in four local oil fields.
Part of the proceeds would also go towards acquiring a nine percent stake in the Rubiales oilfield in Columbia which recently started to produce 1,000 barrels of oil daily, it said.
The as yet unlisted Coplex, which is owned by local businessmen, said expected earnings next year from its share in the Columbian oil field were estimated at 88.46 million pesos.
Australia's Coplex Resources owns 77.4 percent of Coplex Energy and the rest is owned by local businessmen.
After the initial public offering, the Australian firm's share will dilute to 55.1 percent, an official of Coplex Energy Corp said.
